items.title: Prime continuous iff completely distributive
items.reviewNote: The textbook cites Raney's characterization but supplies no proof; retained as a book-omission admit rather than an unverified external axiom.

items.title: Sober unit characterization
items.reviewNote: SoberUnitInjective and SoberUnitSurjective now mean actual injectivity and surjectivity of stoneUnitPoint; both equivalences are proved rather than definitional aliases.

items.title: Sober spatial dual equivalence
items.reviewNote: The Lean declaration proves object maps and object-level unit bijections, but it does not define the source categories, contravariant functors on morphisms, functor laws, naturality, or a categorical dual equivalence.

items.title: Sober complete cocomplete retracts
items.reviewNote: Retract closure is proved, but the current limit/colimit record only has an unindexed diagram surrogate with chosen cones, cocones, lifts, and descents; it lacks diagram morphisms, commutativity, factorization, and uniqueness, so it does not formalize categorical completeness or cocompleteness.

items.title: Locally compact distributive duality
items.reviewNote: The object maps, Stone units, bijectivity, and local-compactness/continuity ingredients are proved, but the restricted categories, morphism actions, functor laws, naturality, and categorical dual equivalence are not encoded.

items.title: Coherent arithmetic duality
items.reviewNote: The object-level restriction and unit bijections are proved, but the coherent/arithmetic categories, contravariant morphism maps, functor laws, naturality, and categorical dual equivalence remain unformalized.

items.title: Algebraic distributive duality

items.title: Spectral algebraic arithmetic duality

items.title: Algebraic arithmetic lattice equivalence
